# Grape ForceSimulation

Vendored unchanged from https://github.com/li3zhen1/Grape, tag `1.1.0`,
commit `48eb7d8` (2025-01-16). MIT license: see LICENSE.
Only the ForceSimulation Swift sources are included; no SwiftUI timer or rendering code.

The LingroveGraphLayout target supplies a small public adapter because upstream exposes
particle storage with Swift `package` access. This keeps upstream buffers inside their
package and the application works with copied SIMD values. The app owns scheduling.
